text: {"lessons":["Selling repeatedly below cost can crystallize losses; decide whether to exit based on forward prospects and risk, not a desire to escape or recover my purchase price.","Frequent trading and shifting among stocks during a broad account decline can add risk without improving returns; review the portfolio as a whole and keep diversification in mind.","Use a consistent, evidence-based plan for entries and exits, and avoid reacting to short-term price moves without enough evidence."]}
